title: 5 FUNNIEST MOMENTS IN HISTORY
text: You won't believe number one. Here are the five funniest moments in history, and every single one is real.

title: THE ARMY THAT FOUGHT ITSELF
text: Number five. In 1788, legend says an Austrian army got drunk, panicked in the dark, and started fighting itself. Nobody won.

title: PIGEON-GUIDED MISSILES
text: Number four. In World War Two, a famous scientist trained pigeons to steer missiles. By pecking at a screen. The army said no thanks.

title: NASA'S $125 MILLION MIX-UP
text: Number three. In 1999, NASA lost a hundred and twenty five million dollar Mars probe, because one team used imperial units and the other used metric.

title: NAPOLEON VS. RABBITS
text: Number two. Napoleon, the conqueror of Europe, went on a rabbit hunt. Reportedly, the rabbits charged at him instead. He retreated.

title: THE GREAT EMU WAR
text: And number one. In 1932, Australia sent soldiers with machine guns to fight twenty thousand emus. They fired nearly ten thousand rounds. The emus won.
